blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Enforcement defenses against prompt injection, such as CaMeL, Progent, IPIGuard and DRIFT, ask the agent's own model to write a security artifact (a program, a privilege policy, a dependency graph or a constraint list) that code then enforces. We ask whether small language model (SLM) agents can be trusted to write these artifacts. Across 15 open-weight models, 13 of them between 1.7B and 12B parameters, they cannot: the policies, graphs and constraints that the agent's model writes admit attacks on 14 (Progent), 13 (IPIGuard) and 11 (DRIFT) of the models, and CaMeL's programs fail to run in up to 68% of episodes. We present CapLite, which derives its policy from the tool schemas, commits the write calls before any tool result is read, and admits a write only if every argument that decides whom or what it affects is stated in the user's request. This guarantees write integrity: injected text cannot add a write, and no write reaches a recipient, amount, object or destination that the user did not state. No attack succeeds in 13,935 attacked AgentDojo episodes. CapLite reaches utility under attack comparable to CaMeL's (29.0% vs. 27.2%) with fewer tokens than every other enforcement defense and than the undefended agent: 17.1k per episode, 18% of CaMeL's, and the highest utility per token of all enforcement defenses.
blocks.zh: 防止迅速注射的执法防御,如CaMeL,Progent,IPIGuard和DRIFT,请代理商自己的模型写一个安全文物(程序,特权政策,依赖性图表或约束列表),然后执行代码. 我们问,能否信任小型语言模型(SLM)代理人来撰写这些文物。 在15个开放量级模型中,其中13个在1.7B到12B参数之间,它们不能:代理商模型所写的政策,图表和限制都承认对模型中的14个(Progent),13个(IPIGuard)和11个(DRIFT)的攻击,CaMeL的节目未能在68%的剧集中运行. 我们介绍CapLite,它的政策来源于工具计划,在读到任何工具结果之前就进行写字呼叫,并且只有在决定谁或影响什么的每个论点都在用户的要求中陈述时才承认写字. 这保证了书写的完整性:注入的文字不能添加书写,并且没有书写到达用户没有说明的收件人,数量,对象或目的地. 在13,935次攻击中没有成功。 CapLite在攻击下达到与CaMeL(29.0%对27.2%)相当的效用,其代号比其他每个执行防卫和不设防代理人都少:每集17.1k,占CaMeL的18%,是所有执行防卫每个代号的最高效用.

blocks.en: A tool-using agent reads e-mails, files and web pages that anyone can write, and an instruction hidden in that content can redirect what the agent does ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) . The defenses with the strongest guarantees take the decision out of the model’s context and give it to code. CaMeL runs a program in an interpreter that tracks where every value came from ( Debenedetti et al., 2025 ) , Progent checks each call against a privilege policy ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , IPIGuard executes a tool dependency graph planned before any tool result is read ( An et al., 2025 ) , and DRIFT validates calls against a planned trajectory and parameter checklist ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 使用工具的代理阅读任何人都能写的电子邮件,文件和网页,隐藏在该内容中的指令可以重定向代理的行为(Greshake等人,2023年;Debenedetti等人,2024年). 拥有最强保证的辩护方会从模型的背景中做出决定,并把它交给代码. CaMeL在一个解释器中运行一个程序,跟踪每个值来自何处(Debedenetti等人,2025年),Progent对照特权政策检查每个呼叫(Shi等人,2025年),IPIGuard在读取任何工具结果之前执行一个计划的工具依赖性图表(An等人,2025年),DRIFT对照计划轨迹和参数清单验证呼叫(Li等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Each of these defenses enforces something the agent’s own model writes: CaMeL the program, Progent the policy, IPIGuard the dependency graph and DRIFT the trajectory and checklist. The enforcement is exactly as sound as this security artifact. All four were designed and evaluated mainly with large hosted models. Concurrent request-grounded authorization systems ( Ma et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) also target large hosted models, and most of them have a model compile the authorization, which is again a model-written security artifact. Meanwhile, small open-weight language models (SLMs) are an increasingly common backbone for agents that run locally, on device or at scale ( Erdogan et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2024 ; Haque et al., 2025 ) . We ask whether SLM agents can be trusted to write their own defenses, and what can be guaranteed if they cannot .
blocks.zh: 每个辩护人都执行代理商自己的模型写的东西: CaMeL程序, Progent the policy, IPIGuard 依赖图和DRIFT 轨迹和核对表. 执法行动和这个安全文物一样健全 所有这四个都主要是用大型主机模型设计和评价的。 同时期请求基于授权系统(马等,2026b;李等,2026b;廖等,2026;范等,2026)也针对大型主机型号,大部分有模型编译授权,这再次成为模型写作的安全文物. 同时,小型开放量级语言模型(SLMS)是当地、设备或规模运行的代理商越来越常见的支柱(Erdogan等人,2024年;Shen等人,2024年;Haque等人,2025年)。 我们问解运人员是否可以信任他们写自己的辩护词,如果他们不能写,可以保证什么。

blocks.en: We measure four enforcement defenses on 15 open-weight models with AgentDojo. Artifacts that decide what is allowed fail open : policies written by the agent’s model admit attacks on 14 of 15 models, IPIGuard’s graphs on 13 of 15, and DRIFT’s constraints on 11 of 15. Artifacts that decide what runs fail closed : CaMeL is breached in only 20 of 13,935 attacked episodes, but its programs fail to run in up to 68% of episodes and cost 94k tokens per episode. These failure rates show no trend with model capability, while the undefended agent follows injections more often as the model gets stronger.
blocks.zh: 我们用15个开放式模型 和Dojo探员测量了4个执法防御 由代理商模式编写的政策承认攻击15种模型中的14种, IPIGuard的图表显示15种模型中的13种, 以及DRIFT在15种模型中的11种。 决定什么运行失败关闭的艺术: CaMeL在13,935个被攻击的节目中只有20个被违反,但其节目未能在68%的节目中运行,每集花费94k个令牌. 这些故障率没有显示模型能力的趋势,而无防守剂随着模型的增强而更频繁地跟随注射.

blocks.en: An SLM agent does not need to write its own authorization. CapLite derives its policy from tool schemas by fixed rules and takes every security decision in deterministic code. A Planner that sees only the request commits the write calls before any tool result is read, a Binder fills each open argument by choosing among extracted candidates, and a Mediator admits a write only if every authority argument, such as a recipient, an amount, an object identifier or a URL, equals a value stated in the request. A model failure can drop a write or pick a wrong candidate, and injected text can neither add a write nor route one to a value the user did not state; we call this guarantee write integrity . No attack succeeds in 13,935 attacked episodes, as these properties predict, and CapLite reaches utility under attack comparable to CaMeL’s with 18% of its tokens. It uses fewer tokens than every other enforcement defense and than the undefended agent, and it gives the highest utility per token of all enforcement defenses.
blocks.zh: 可持续土地管理代理人不需要自己写授权书。 CapLite通过固定规则从工具图谋中获得其政策,并在确定性守则中作出每一项安全决定。 在读取任何工具结果之前只看到请求的策划者会执行写呼,Binder通过在所选候选人中选择来填充每个开放的参数,而调解人只有在每个权威参数,如接收者,一个数量,一个对象标识符或一个URL,等于请求中声明的值时才会承认一个字符. 模型失败可以丢弃一个写法或选择一个错误的候选,而注入的文本既不能添加一个写法,也不能给用户未声明的值设置一条路由;我们称这个保证书写完整. . 在13,935次攻击中,没有成功,正如这些属性预测的那样,CapLite在攻击中达到了效用,与CaMeL相当,其18 % 的标志。 它使用的符号比其他每个执行防卫和不设防的代理人都少,它给予所有执行防卫的每个符号的最高效用.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Measurement. A study of four enforcement defenses on 15 open-weight models, which shows that security artifacts written by the agent’s own model inherit its failures across the whole range from 1.7B to 35B: artifacts that decide what is allowed admit attacks, and artifacts that decide what runs lose the task (Section 2 ). • Architecture. CapLite, a design in which the model proposes and code authorizes, combining committed writes, schema-derived field roles, exact request grounding and candidate-only binding (Section 3 ). Its two properties hold by construction, no attack succeeds in 13,935 attacked episodes, and ablations show that the Mediator and the commitment of writes are each needed (Section 5 ). • Efficiency. CapLite uses fewer tokens than every other enforcement defense and than the undefended agent, and reaches utility under attack comparable to CaMeL’s with the highest utility per thousand tokens of all enforcement defenses (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:衡量。 对15个开放量级模型的四项执法辩护的研究显示,由特工自己模型撰写的安全文物继承其失败,范围从1.7B到35B不等:决定允许什么攻击的文物和决定什么跑掉任务的文物(第2节)。 • 建筑。 CapLite,一种模型建议和代码授权的设计,结合承诺书写,计划衍生的场面角色,精确请求的落地和只约束候选人(第3节). 在13,935起攻击事件中, 攻击没有成功, • 效率。 CapLite使用比其他每个执法防御和无防守代理人少的代号,并在攻击下达到相当于CaMeL的效用,每千个代号具有最高的效用(第5节)。

blocks.en: 2 Can SLM Agents Write Their Own Defenses?
blocks.zh: 2 SLM特工可以写他们自己的辩护吗?

blocks.en: We call a model output a security artifact when the enforcer admits whatever it contains. For each of the 15 models, we run every defense with that model in all of its model roles, on the setup and metrics of Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们称一个模型输出 安全文物 当执行者承认它包含的一切。 对于15个模型中的每一个,我们运行 每一个防御与该模型 在所有的模型角色, 设置和度量 第4节。

blocks.en: Progent asks the model to write a privilege policy from the request and to update it after each call. The policies admit attacks on 14 of 15 models, 676 in total and up to 132 of 929 on Qwen3-32B (Figure 2 ). The same policies block 25–77% of the write calls the agent attempts under attack (Appendix C ), and benign utility falls from 59.4% undefended to 43.8%, so a generated policy is wrong in both directions. IPIGuard’s planner commits a dependency graph and DRIFT’s a trajectory and parameter checklist that a validator enforces; IPIGuard is breached on 13 of 15 models (435 attacks) and DRIFT on 11 of 15 (214 attacks; Figure 2 ). DRIFT’s four clean models, LFM2.5-2.6B, Gemma-4-E2B, Gemma-4-E4B and Granite-4.2-8B, complete 4.7%, 9.5%, 6.7% and 4.7% of attacked tasks, so their zero comes from inaction.
blocks.zh: Progent要求模型从请求中写出特权政策,并在每次呼叫后更新. 这些政策承认15种模式中有14种受到攻击,其中676种受到攻击,929种攻击中有132种受到攻击(图2)。 同样的政策阻断了25–77 %的笔迹,称代理试图遭到攻击(附录C),良性效用从59.4%不设防下降到43.8%,因此产生的政策在两个方向上都是错误的. IPIGuard的策划者使用依赖图和DRIFT的轨迹和参数清单,由验证者执行;IPIGuard在15种模式中的13种(435次攻击)和15种模式中的11种(214次攻击;图2)被违反。 DRIFT的4个清洁型号,LFM2.5-2.6B,Gemma-4-E2B,Gemma-4-E4B和Granite-4.2-8B,完成4.7%,9.5%,6.7%和4.7%的受攻击任务,因此他们的零来自不作为.

blocks.en: CaMeL’s interpreter enforces the authors’ data-flow policies on whatever program the model writes, and security holds: 20 successful attacks in 13,935 episodes, 17 of them on LFM2.5-2.6B. On 8 of the 15 models the final program is unrunnable in more than 15% of episodes, and on Granite-4.2-8B in 68%, where the model returns no code at all (Appendix C ). The causes are format, syntax and interpreter errors that survive up to ten repair rounds, each costing more calls: CaMeL spends 94k tokens per episode (Appendix H , Case 2), and its benign utility averages 24.9% (undefended: 59.4%).

blocks.en: Within the Qwen3 (1.7B–32B) and Gemma-4 (E2B–12B) families, the attack success rate under Progent and IPIGuard rises monotonically with model size, together with that of the undefended agent (Figure 3 ); under Progent it grows from 3.0% to 14.2% on Qwen3 and from 0% to 12.7% on Gemma-4. A larger model is easier to inject, and the policies and graphs it writes do not absorb the extra risk. CaMeL’s programs are the exception on Gemma-4, where the share without a runnable program falls from 22.9% to 3.3%, which matches CaMeL’s higher utility on the two larger Gemma-4 models (Section 5 ). Across all 15 models, no artifact failure rate shows a significant trend with capability ( | ρ | ≤ 0.33 |\rho|\leq 0.33 , p > 0.2 p>0.2 ).

blocks.en: In each defense the enforcement is sound relative to its artifact, and the agent’s own model writes the artifact. When the artifact decides what is allowed, the model’s mistakes become admitted attacks; when it decides what runs, they become lost tasks and repeated calls. Enforcement that must hold for any model therefore cannot rely on an artifact that the model writes.
blocks.zh: 在每次辩护中,执行与它的文物相比是健全的,代理商自己的模型写作文物。 当文物决定什么是允许的时,模型的错误会变成被承认的攻击;当它决定什么是运行时,它们会变成丢失的任务和重复的呼叫. 因此,任何模型都不得依赖模型所写的文物。

blocks.en: CapLite never lets the model decide what is authorized. Authorization comes from two things that code computes: a policy derived from the tool schemas and the set 𝒢 ⁡ ( q ) \mathcal{G}(q){} of values the request states. The model proposes a plan, a choice among extracted candidates and text; the Mediator executes a proposal only if it matches the policy and every authority argument lies in 𝒢 ⁡ ( q ) \mathcal{G}(q){} . A wrong proposal is dropped or denied. The Mediator rejects every write that was not committed and every authority value the request does not state. Figure 4 shows the pipeline; all model calls use one SLM.

blocks.en: The user, the request q q that starts an episode, the tools and their documentation are trusted. Tool results are not: an attacker controls arbitrary text inside the data that read tools return, such as e-mails, files, web pages, reviews or transaction subjects, and succeeds when the agent performs a write that serves the attacker’s goal. The guarantee holds whatever instructions the model follows, so adaptive attacks that bypass model-level defenses ( Zhan et al., 2025 ) leave it intact; Section 4 lists the attacks we run, including two written against CapLite’s design.

blocks.en: 3.1 Schema-derived policy
blocks.zh: 3.1 源自司马政策

blocks.en: The policy comes from what any tool registry exposes: the tool name, its docstring and its JSON parameter schema. A tool is read-only when the first verbs of its name and docstring are both read verbs ( get , search , list , …), a write tool when either is an effect verb ( send , create , pay , …), and unclassified otherwise; the Mediator denies unclassified tools, so an unfamiliar verb costs utility. Every argument of a write tool is an authority field unless the schema marks it as free text ( payload ), a date or time ( temporal ) or an enum or boolean ( control ). A destination such as a URL is authority even in a read-only tool, because fetching an attacker-chosen URL is itself an effect. Authority fields decide whom or what a write affects: recipients, participants, accounts, amounts, channels, object identifiers and destinations. Appendix A lists the verb and token lists and the classification of all 74 tools.
blocks.zh: 该政策来自任何工具注册所暴露的内容:工具名称,其docstring及其JSON参数schema. 当一个工具的名称和docstring的第一个动词既是读动词( get, search, list,...),一个写作工具,当其中任何一个都是效果动词(发送,创建,支付,......),而不是解密;调解人否认未解密的工具,所以不熟悉的动词成本效用. 写作工具的每个参数都是权威字段,除非计划将其标记为自由文本(有效载荷)、日期或时间(时间)或enum或布尔(控制)。 URL这样的目的地甚至在只读工具中也是权威,因为获取攻击者选择的URL本身就是一种效果. 权限域决定写作对谁或影响什么:收件人,参与者,账户,金额,渠道,对象识别符和目的地. 附 录 A列出动词和符号列表,以及所有74个工具的分类.

blocks.en: 3.2 Adaptive reads, committed writes
blocks.zh: 3.2 适应性读写,承诺书写

blocks.en: Planner. One schema-constrained call sees only q q and the tool documentation and returns at most ten tool calls, with each argument either copied from the request or left as a placeholder such as $event_id . Its write calls are committed : no later component can add, remove or reorder them.
blocks.zh: 计师曰. 一个有计划限制的呼叫只看到 q q 和工具文档,最多返回十个工具呼叫,每个参数要么从请求中复制,要么作为占位符如 $event_id. 它的写作呼叫是被承诺的:任何后期组件都无法添加,删除或重排.

blocks.en: Reader. A loop of at most ten read-only tool calls that sees the request and the committed writes and adapts its lookups to what it reads. Its calls also pass the Mediator, so a read whose destination the request does not state is refused.
blocks.zh: 读者. 最多10个只读工具调用的一个循环,可以看到请求和承诺书写,并调整其外观以适应其读取的内容. 其电话也通过调解人,因此,请求未指明目的地的读物被拒绝。

blocks.en: Binder and Composer. For each placeholder, CapLite extracts typed candidate values from the observations; for an authority or control field it keeps only values in the request’s grounding set 𝒢 ⁡ ( q ) \mathcal{G}(q){} , the exact values and token n n -grams that q q states (Appendix G ). The Binder picks one candidate identifier under constrained decoding, or answers none or ask , and never writes a value. The Composer writes payload text from the request and the observations.
blocks.zh: 宾德和作曲家. 对于每个占位符, CapLite 从观测结果中提取打入的候选值; 对于一个权威或控制字段, 它只保留请求定位集 G Q 的值( q )\ mathcal{G}( q) Q 的值, q 表示的确切值和符号 n - gram( 附录 G ) 。 Binder在受限制的解码下选择一个候选标识, 作曲家从请求和观测中写入有效载荷文本.

blocks.en: Mediator. Before each committed write, deterministic code checks that the tool is classified, no placeholder remains, the arguments match the schema and every authority argument equals a member of 𝒢 ⁡ ( q ) \mathcal{G}(q){} exactly; a substring of the request does not count. The first denial, confirmation request or tool error stops the remaining writes. A Reporter then answers from the observations.
blocks.zh: 调解人。 在每次承诺书写前,确定密码检查工具是否被分类,没有占位符留下,参数匹配计划,每个权威参数等于G QQ (q)\mathcal{G}(q)QQ;请求的子字符串不计数. 第一个拒绝,确认请求或工具错误会阻止剩余的写作. 一个记者然后从观察中回答.

blocks.en: When an authority value appears only in a tool result, for example a recipient the user describes but does not name, no grounded candidate exists and CapLite asks the user to confirm. Our evaluation answers no such request and counts the episode as a failure (Appendix H , Case 3).
blocks.zh: 当一个权威值只出现在工具结果中,例如一个收件人,用户描述但没有名字时,就不存在有根据的候选人,CapLite要求用户确认. 我们的评价没有回应这样的要求,将这集算作失败(Appendix H, Case 3).

blocks.en: Two properties hold by construction in every episode.
blocks.zh: 每集都有两处地产

blocks.en: 1. Committed writes. The executed write calls are a prefix of the write calls the Planner committed before any tool result was read, in the same order. 2. Request grounding. Every authority argument of every executed write is an element of 𝒢 ⁡ ( q ) \mathcal{G}(q){} or a value the user confirmed.

blocks.en: Injected text can therefore change which reads the Reader performs, temporal values and the final answer, but it cannot add a write, choose a different write tool, or redirect a recipient, account, amount, channel, object or destination to a value the user did not state. The text of a free-text argument, such as a message body, is written by the Composer and is not constrained. A trace audit re-derives the policy and 𝒢 ⁡ ( q ) \mathcal{G}(q){} from the logged request and tool registry, outside the running agent, and checks every executed call: no violation occurs in 25,452 CapLite episodes across all models and attacks.
blocks.zh: 因此,注入的文本可以更改读取 Reader 执行的文本、时间值和最后的答案,但它不能添加一个写入、选择另一个写入工具,或者将一个收件人、账户、金额、频道、对象或目的地重定向到用户没有说明的值。 自由文字参数的文本,如消息体,由作曲者书写,不受约束. 一次跟踪审计从运行的代理商外的登录请求和工具注册处重新提取了政策和G QQ( q)\ mathcal{G}( q)} , 并检查每一次已执行的呼叫: 25 452次没有发生违法事件 CapLite事件贯穿所有模型和攻击.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We use the AgentDojo benchmark v1.2.2 ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) with its four suites (Workspace, Slack, Banking, Travel), 97 user tasks and 949 pairs of a user task with an injection task. Benign utility uses the 97 user tasks without injection; utility under attack uses all 949 pairs. Attack success rate uses the 929 pairs whose injection goal needs a tool call; the other 20 pairs are the one Travel goal that asks only for a sentence in the final answer. It involves no write, so it lies outside write integrity (Section 3.2 ): CapLite does not defend it (Case 5 in Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用AgentDojo基准v1.2.2(Debenedetti等人,2024年)及其四套套套房(Workspace,Slack,Banking,Travel),97个用户任务和949对有注射任务的用户任务. Benign 工具使用97个用户任务而不注入;攻击下的工具使用所有949对. 攻击成功率使用注射进球需要工具呼叫的929对;其他20对则是旅行进球,在最终答案中只要求一个句子. 它不涉及书写,所以它位于书写完整性之外(第3.2节): CapLite不为其辩护(附录H第5号案件)。

blocks.en: We evaluate 15 open-weight models: 13 small models from 1.7B to 12B parameters (Qwen3-1.7B, -4B, -4B-Instruct-2507 and -8B, Yang et al., 2025 ; Qwen3.5-4B and -9B, Qwen Team, 2026a ; Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Gemma-4-E2B, -E4B and -12B, Gemma Team et al., 2026 ; Granite-4.2-8B, IBM Granite Team, 2026 ; Ministral-3-8B, Liu et al., 2026 ; LFM2.5-2.6B, Liquid AI, 2026 ) and two larger references, Qwen3-32B and the mixture-of-experts Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) . All models are served with vLLM 0.30.0 ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) and native tool calling, with temperature 0, seed 0, thinking disabled and at most 2,048 output tokens per call (8,192 for DRIFT’s calls, Appendix E ).

Team等人,2026年;Granite-4.2-8B,IBM Granite Team, 2026; Ministryal-3-8B, Liu等人, 2026; LFM2.5-2.6B, Liquid AI, 2026)和两个更大的参考文献, Qune3-32B和专家的混合 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B(Quen Team,2026b ). 所有型号都配有vLLM 0.30.0(Kwon等人,2023年)和本地工具调用,温度0,种子0,思维障碍,每次调用最多2,048个输出符(DRIFT的调用8,192个,附录E).

blocks.en: Every defense uses the same SLM for every model role it defines. Undefended is AgentDojo’s tool-calling agent. AgentDojo’s four built-in defenses (tool filter, spotlighting, repeated user prompt and a prompt-injection detector) run on eight models and appear in Appendix B . CaMeL ( Debenedetti et al., 2025 ) uses the authors’ code and per-suite security policies, with the SLM as both privileged and quarantined model. Progent ( Shi et al., 2025 ) uses the authors’ policy generation and updates and their always-allowed read tools. As in their code, the temperature rises by 0.2 after each policy that fails to parse. IPIGuard ( An et al., 2025 ) uses the authors’ prompts, graph planner and read-only whitelist. DRIFT ( Li et al., 2025 ) uses the authors’ planner, validator and injection isolator and runs on all 15 models. Its parser change is described in Appendix E . Every port keeps the authors’ algorithm and prompts and changes only the model interface (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 每个辩护方对它定义的每一个模范角色使用相同的可持续土地管理. 无防守是Dojo探员的工具调用代理。 探员 Dojo的4个内置防御(工具过滤器,聚光灯,重复用户提示器和即时注射探测器)运行在8个模型上,并在附录B中出现. CaMeL(Debenedetti等人,2025年)使用作者的代码和套装安全政策,而可持续土地管理既是特权模式,也是隔离模式。 Progent(Shi等人,2025年)使用作者的政策制定和更新及其总是被允许使用的阅读工具。 和他们的代码一样,温度上升了0.2 每一个政策没有分析。 IPIGuard(An et al.,2025)使用作者的提示,图表规划器和只读的白名单. DRIFT(Li等人,2025年)使用作者的策划器、验证器和注射隔离器,并运行在所有15种模型上。 附录E介绍了其参数变化。 每个端口都保留作者的算法并提示,只更改模型接口(Appendix E ).

blocks.en: The main attack is AgentDojo’s important_instructions . Robustness experiments on eight models (Qwen3-1.7B, -4B, -4B-Instruct-2507, -8B and -32B; Llama-3.1-8B; Gemma-4-E4B and -12B) add tool_knowledge , which also names the tools the attacker wants called, and two attacks that target CapLite’s design: read exfiltration asks the agent to fetch an attacker URL with a read-only tool, and descriptor collision plants a record that carries the user’s own descriptor (Appendix F ).

blocks.en: No attack succeeds against CapLite on any of the 15 models, 0 of 13,935 episodes (Table 1 ), and the trace audit confirms that both properties of Section 3.2 held in every episode. blocks.en: CapLite and CaMeL have comparable utility under attack, averaging 29.0% and 27.2% over the 15 models (Figure 5 ). CapLite is higher on Granite-4.2-8B ( + 21.3 +21.3 points), where CaMeL rarely obtains a program, and on LFM2.5-2.6B ( + 6.8 +6.8 ). CaMeL is higher on Gemma-4-E4B ( − 12.2 -12.2 ) and Gemma-4-12B ( − 13.5 -13.5 ), which write CaMeL programs reliably (3–14% failures) and can then loop over records and branch on their content. blocks.zh: CapLite和CaMeL在攻击中具有类似的效用,平均比15种型号的29.0%和27.2%(图5)。 CapLite在Granite-4.2-8B(+21.3+21.3分)上较高,CaMeL很少获得一个程序,在LFM2.5-2.6B(+6.8+6.8)上CaMEL在Gemma-4-E4B(−12.2-12.2)和Gemma-4-12B(−13.5-13.5)上较高,CaMel程序写得可靠(3–14%的失败),然后可以循环记录和内容分支. CapLite在24.4%的攻击事件中至少执行一个写法,而CaMeL的写法为26.2%.

blocks.en: Against the undefended agent, CapLite’s utility under attack is 21 points lower (29.0% against 50.2%). Most of the gap comes from the small model’s planning (Appendix D ). In 43% of CapLite’s benign failures the committed plan misses a write the task needs, and in 38% every committed write runs, or a read-only task is answered, but the task still fails; a plan without code also cannot loop or branch on observed data. Requests for confirmation, where an authority value appears only in a tool result, account for 8–12% of the failures (Appendix H , Case 3).

blocks.en: 5.3 Cost and efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.3 成本和效率

blocks.en: CapLite uses 17.1k tokens per episode, against 93.7k for CaMeL, 63.4k for Progent, 60.5k for IPIGuard, 28.1k for DRIFT and 28.0k for the undefended agent (Table 1 ). Of the two defenses with zero or near-zero ASR (CapLite 0, CaMeL 20 of 13,935), CapLite reaches the same utility at 5.5 times lower cost. To compare utility and cost directly, we report utility per thousand tokens (UA/kTok), the utility under attack divided by the tokens per episode in thousands. CapLite reaches 1.69, against 1.24 for DRIFT, 0.64 for Progent, 0.59 for IPIGuard and 0.29 for CaMeL, and it has the highest value of the enforcement defenses on 12 of the 15 models.
blocks.zh: CapLite每集使用17.1k令牌,而CaMeL为93.7k,Progent为63.4k,IPIGuard为60.5k,DRIFT为28.1k,无防守代理为28.0k(表1). 在两个具有0或近0ASR(CapLite 0,CaMeL 20 of 13,935)的防御器中,CapLite以5.5倍的低成本达到相同的用途. 为了直接比较效用和成本,我们每千个令牌(UA/kTok)报告效用,被攻击的令牌除以每集千个令牌. CapLite达到1.69,相对于DRIFT的1.24,Progent的0.64,IPIGuard的0.59和CaMeL的0.29,它在15种型号中的12种型号上执法防御值最高.

blocks.en: 5.4 The security–utility–cost trade-off
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 安全-效用-成本权衡

blocks.en: Figure 1 places all defenses on one plane of attack success, utility and cost. DRIFT, IPIGuard and Progent sit at the high-utility end: their utility under attack is 34.9%, 35.7% and 40.6%, between 5.9 and 11.6 points above CapLite’s, and they admit 214, 435 and 676 attacks at 1.6, 3.5 and 3.7 times CapLite’s token cost. Specifically, DRIFT has no successful attack only on LFM2.5-2.6B, Gemma-4-E2B, Gemma-4-E4B and Granite-4.2-8B, where it completes 4.7%, 9.5%, 6.7% and 4.7% of attacked tasks; Progent has none on one model and IPIGuard on two. CapLite and CaMeL sit at the other end, with no or near-no successful attack on every model, and CapLite is the cheapest point there. The defenses that write their own artifacts therefore buy utility with attacks, and among the defenses without successful attacks CapLite gives the most utility per token.
blocks.zh: 图1将所有防御工作置于攻击成功、效用和成本的一面。 DRIFT、IPIGuard和Progent坐落在高功用端:他们受到攻击的功用为34.9%、35.7%和40.6%,高于CapLite的5.9至11.6点,他们以1.6、3.5和3.7倍CapLite的象征性成本接受了214、435和676次攻击。 具体来说,DRIFT没有成功攻击LFM2.5-2.6B,Gemma-4-E2B,Gemma-4-E4B和Granite-4.2-8B,完成4.7%,9.5%,6.7%和4.7%的攻击任务;Progent一个型号没有成功攻击,IPIGuard两个型号没有成功攻击. CapLite和CaMeL坐在另一端,对每个型号都没有或几乎没有成功的攻击,CapLite是那里最便宜的点. 因此,写自己的文物的防御工事通过攻击购买实用性,在没有成功攻击的防御工事中,CapLite给每个符号提供了最大的实用性.

Removing the Mediator also removes the grounding filter on the Binder’s candidates, so observed values can fill authority arguments: benign utility rises by 5.6 points, utility under attack by 3.5, and 106 of 7,432 attacks succeed (ASR 1.4%), on every one of the eight models. blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Indirect prompt injection was demonstrated on deployed LLM applications by Greshake et al. (2023) , and BIPIA ( Yi et al., 2025 ) and AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) measure it for LLM applications and agents. Narisetty et al. (2026) argue that defenses outside the model are untested against adaptive attacks, apply an adaptive-attack protocol to Progent, and argue that model-authored policies strain verifiability.
blocks.zh: Greshake等人(2023年)和BIPIA(Yi等人,2025年)和Agent Dojo(Debenderetti等人,2024年)在所部署的LLM应用上演示了间接快速注射,用于LLM应用和剂. Narisetty等人(2026年)认为,模型外的防御对适应性攻击没有进行测试,对Progent适用适应性攻击协议,并称模型授权的政策会影响可核查性.

blocks.en: Spotlighting marks untrusted text ( Hines et al., 2024 ) , and StruQ ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , SecAlign ( Chen et al., 2025b ) and Meta-SecAlign ( Chen et al., 2025c ) train the model to ignore instructions in data ( Ye et al., 2026 , see also) . MELON ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) , AgentSentry ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and AttriGuard ( He et al., 2026 ) re-execute the task with a masked user prompt or counterfactual observations and flag calls that depend on the injected content. Tool result parsing ( Yu et al., 2026 ) filters what reaches the model, and ARGUS ( Weng et al., 2026 ) releases a state-changing call only when model sub-agents trace it to benign evidence.
blocks.zh: (Hines等人,2024年)和StruQ (Chen等人,2025a), SecAlign (Chen等人,2025b)和Meta-SecAlign (Chen等人,2025c) 训练模型忽略数据中的指令(Ye等人,2026,另见). MELON(Zhu等人,2025b),AgentSentry(Zhang等人,2026年)和AttriGuard(He等人,2026年)重新执行任务,使用一个蒙面用户即时或反事实观察和旗下调用依赖于注入内容. 工具结果解析(Yu等人,2026年)过滤了到达模型的内容,而ARGUS(Weng等人,2026年)只有在模型子代理追踪到良性证据时才会发布改变状态的呼叫.

blocks.en: The dual-LLM pattern ( Willison, 2023 ) and the plan-then-execute pattern ( Beurer-Kellner et al., 2025 ) fix the control flow before untrusted data is read. ACE ( Li et al., 2026a ) adds data and capability barriers at execution, and f-secure ( Wu et al., 2024 ) information-flow control. In the plain pattern an injection can still choose the arguments of planned calls, which CapLite closes with exact request grounding. CaMeL ( Debenedetti et al., 2025 ) and FIDES ( Costa et al., 2025 ) track provenance with capabilities or information-flow labels, RTBAS ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) gates calls on labels, Progent ( Shi et al., 2025 ) and Conseca ( Tsai and Bagdasarian, 2025 ) generate policies, IPIGuard ( An et al., 2025 ) and DRIFT ( Li et al., 2025 ) plan graphs and constraints, and Task Shield ( Jia et al., 2025 ) , MiniScope ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) and ClawGuard ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) check goal alignment or restrict privileges at the tool boundary. CapLite adds argument integrity to plan-then-execute without a model-written program or policy.
blocks.zh: 双LLM图案(Willison, 2023)和当时的计划执行图案(Beurer-Kellner等人, 2025年)在读取不可信数据之前固定控制流. ACE(Li等人,2026a)增加了执行时的数据和能力障碍,f-security(Wu等人,2024)信息流控制. 在平坦的图案中,注射器仍然可以选择有计划的呼叫的论据,CapLite用精确的请求关闭这些参数。 CaMeL(Debenderetti等人,2025年)和FIDES(Costa等人,2025年)追踪有能力或信息流标签的出处,RTBAS(Zhong等人,2025年)门户调用标签,Progent(Shi等人,2025年)和Conseca(Tsai和Bagdasarian,2025年)生成政策,IPIGuard(An等人,2025年)和DRIFT(Li等人,2025年)计划图表和限制,以及Task Shield(Jia等人,2025年),MiniScope。 (Zhu等人,2025a)和ClawGuard (Zhao等人,2026)在工具边界检查球门对齐或限制权限. CapLite在没有模型写程序或政策的情况下,将参数完整性添加到当时的计划执行中.

blocks.en: Concurrent systems also require sensitive arguments to originate from trusted sources. PACT ( Fan et al., 2026 ) assigns semantic roles to arguments and tracks the provenance of their values. ROPE ( Ma et al., 2026b ) checks the origin of sensitive arguments deterministically. ToolFence ( Li et al., 2026b ) , TraceGrant ( Liao et al., 2026 ) , IntentCap ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) and MetaPermit ( Ma et al., 2026a ) enforce authorization plans, contracts or capability leases that a model derives from the request, or attributes that a model infers for each call. SARA ( Guo et al., 2026 ) checks each argument against the user objective and audited execution evidence, and CXI ( Santos-Grueiro, 2026 ) against protected fields declared in its policy. CapLite derives its policy from the tool schemas by fixed rules, so no model compiles, labels or extends the authorization: ToolFence, TraceGrant and IntentCap have a model compile it, PACT uses a model for ambiguous roles and for provenance, and ROPE’s list of sensitive fields was written by a model offline. Like TraceGrant, CapLite fixes its writes before reading, which the replanning ablation shows to be necessary.
blocks.zh: 同时期系统也要求敏感的论点来自可信来源. PACT (Fan et al., 2026) 将语义角色指派给参数,并跟踪其值的来源. ROPE(Ma等人,2026b)从决定性的角度检查敏感论点的来源。 ToolFence (Li et al., 2026b), TraceGrant (Liao et al., 2026), IntentCap (Zheng et al., 2026)和MetaPermit (Ma et al., 2026a) 执行一个模型来自请求的授权计划,合同或能力租赁,或一个模型推断每个呼叫的属性. SARA (Guo et al., 2026) 对照用户客观和经审计的执行证据检查每一个论据,以及CXI (Santos-Grueiro, 2026)对照其政策中宣布的保护区. CapLite通过固定规则从工具计划获得其政策,因此没有模型编译,标签或扩展授权: ToolFence, TraceGrant和IntentCap有一个模型来编译它,PACT使用一个模型来表示模棱两可的角色和来源,ROPE的敏感字段列表是由一个模型脱机而成. 与 TraceGrant 一样, CapLite 在阅读前修补其写作, 重新规划衰减显示是必需的.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: SLM agents cannot be trusted to write their own defenses : across 15 open-weight models, the programs, policies, graphs and constraints they write carry their failures into the enforcement, as admitted attacks or lost tasks, and larger models in this range do not write them more reliably. They also do not need to. CapLite takes its policy from tool schemas and its allowed values from the request, and its write integrity holds by construction. With no successful attack on any of the 15 models, it reaches CaMeL’s utility under attack with 18% of its tokens and gives the highest utility per token of all enforcement defenses.
blocks.zh: 无法相信SLM代理人会写出自己的防守:在15个开放量模型中, 它们也没有必要。 CapLite从工具计及其允许的值从请求中取取其政策,其书写完整性通过构建而持有. 由于15种型号中的任何一种型号都没有成功攻击,它以18%的代号到达了CaMeL受到攻击的用途,并给予所有执法防御的每个代号最高的用途。

blocks.en: CaMeL. The authors’ interpreter, privileged and quarantined models and per-suite security policies, with the SLM as both models. Progent. blocks.zh: 附录F 记录依据,一个被拒绝的备选方案

blocks.en: Record grounding would admit the identifier of an observed record whose descriptor (e.g. a file name) equals a phrase of q q . It changes benign utility by − 2.1 -2.1 to + 3.1 +3.1 points across the 15 models, and it opens a channel for an attacker who plants one record (an invitation, a shared file, an e-mail or a scheduled transaction) carrying the user’s own descriptor. This descriptor collision attack succeeds 23 times in 103 episodes with record grounding, 2 in 104 against CaMeL and 0 in 104 against CapLite (on 8 models). A descriptor match says what a record contains, not who created it, so CapLite does not use it.
blocks.zh: 记录定位将承认被观察记录的标识符,其描述符(例如文件名称)相当于q q的短语. 它将良性效用改变为−2.1-2.1到+3.1+3.1分,跨越15种模式,它打开了一个通道,让一个使用用户自己描述词的攻击者安装一个记录(邀请、共享文件、电子邮件或预定交易)。 这一描述式碰撞攻击在103集中成功23次,创纪录地底,在104集中2集对CaMeL,在104集中0集对CapLite(8型). 一个描述符匹配说一个记录包含什么,而不是是谁创建的,所以CapLite不使用.

blocks.en: Appendix G Implementation details
blocks.zh: 附录G 执行情况详情

blocks.en: The grounding set 𝒢 ⁡ ( q ) \mathcal{G}(q){} contains the e-mail addresses, IBANs, URLs, dates, quoted strings and numbers that q q states, and every token n n -gram of q q up to length eight. Strings are canonicalized (lower case, collapsed whitespace, URL scheme removed), and a value is grounded only if it equals a member exactly, so an amount of 1 is not grounded by a request that mentions 100. Candidate values are the scalar leaves of the tool results whose type matches the argument, labelled with their key path and source, at most 32 per placeholder. The Planner, Binder, Composer and Reporter use schema-constrained decoding through vLLM’s structured outputs, and the Binder’s output is an enum over the candidate identifiers plus none and ask . The Planner may commit at most ten calls, the Reader may take at most ten steps, each observation is truncated to 6,000 characters, and the Binder sees at most 32 candidates. Each configuration is run once, with deterministic decoding (temperature 0, fixed seed). The descriptor collision attack plants, for each user task whose ground truth writes to an object identified by an identifier, a copy of the target with a fresh identifier and with its descriptor set to a phrase of the request, and adds an important_instructions injection that names the planted identifier. It succeeds when the planted record is modified, deleted or attached to a sent e-mail.
blocks.zh: 地面设置 G QQ ( q )\ mathcal{G}( q ) QQ 包含电子邮件地址, IBANs, URLs, 日期, 引用的字符串和数字, q 表示, 以及每个符号 n - gram 的 q q , 长度为 8 。 字符串是划线化的(小写,崩溃的白空间,URL方案被移除),一个值只有在完全等于一个成员时才会被基于,因此1的数量不是被提到100的要求所基于的. 候选值是工具结果的刻度叶,其类型与参数相符,贴有其关键路径和源,每个占位符最多32个。 计划员Binder、撰稿人和记者通过 vLLM 的结构化产出使用受约束的系统解码, 计划者最多可发出十次电话,读者最多可采取十次步骤,每次观察都缩短到6000个字符,宾德最多可看到32名候选人. 每个配置都运行一次,带有定型解码(温度0,定型种子). 描述式碰撞攻击工厂,对于每个用户任务,其地面真相写给一个标识符所识别的对象,一份带有新标识符的目标副本及其描述符设定在请求语句上,并增加了一个重要的_指示注射,命名了所植标识符. 当植入的记录被修改、删除或附在发送的电子邮件上时,它就会成功。

blocks.en: All models were served with vLLM 0.30.0 on NVIDIA GPUs with native tool calling and the tool parser recommended for each model family. The total experimental compute cost was an estimated 150 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU-hours. AgentDojo is released under the MIT license, the DRIFT code under MIT and the IPIGuard code under Apache-2.0; every model is used under the license on its model card, for research.
blocks.zh: 所有模型在NVIDIA GPU上都得到了VLLM 0.30.0的服务,上面有本地工具调用,并为每个模型家族推荐了工具解析器. 实验计算总成本估计为150 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU小时. 探员 Dojo根据麻省理工学院的许可证,麻省理工学院的DRIFT代码和Apache-2.0的IPIGuard代码发布;每个型号在其型号卡上的许可证下使用,用于研究.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Case 1: one injected episode, six systems (Qwen3-8B, Banking, user task 14, injection task 1). Red frames mark attacker-controlled text and the write call that serves it. The undefended agent and DRIFT send money to the attacker. Progent blocks the call by policy, IPIGuard executes no transfer, and CaMeL stops with an empty answer. CapLite commits update_password before reading anything, refuses it in the read phase and executes it only through the Mediator.
blocks.zh: 图7:案例1:一个注入插曲,六个系统(Quen3-8B,银行业,用户任务14,注入任务1). 红色帧标记攻击者控制的文字和为它服务的书写呼叫. 无防守特工和DRIFT向攻击者发钱. Progent通过策略屏蔽呼叫,IPIGuard执行不传输,CaMeL以空的答案停止. CapLite 在读到任何东西前执行更新_password, 在读到的阶段拒绝, 并且只通过调解人执行 。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Case 2: a small model and CaMeL’s program (Slack, user task 0, no attack). With Qwen3-1.7B, CaMeL makes 30 model calls and executes no tool; with Granite-4.2-8B its model returns no code. CapLite plans one read whose URL the request states and completes the task with four model calls on both models.
blocks.zh: 图8:案例2:一个小模型和CaMeL的程序(Slack,用户任务0,不攻击). 使用Quen3-1.7B,CaMeL发出30个型号呼叫,执行无工具;使用Granite-4.2-8B,其型号返回无代码. CapLite计划一阅读了请求中说明的URL并用四个模型调用两个模型来完成任务.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Case 3: the cost of asking (Qwen3-8B, Slack, user task 7, no attack). The channel is an authority argument and its name appears only in a tool result, so CapLite has no admissible candidate and asks the user to confirm it. The undefended agent completes the task with a channel it took from a tool result. A simulated user who answers from AgentDojo’s ground truth lets CapLite complete the task with one confirmation.
blocks.zh: 图9:案例3:询问费用(Quen3-8B,Slack,用户任务7,无攻击). 该频道是一个权威论证,其名称只出现在工具结果中,因此CapLite没有可被接受的候选人,并要求用户确认. 未设防的代理用它从工具结果中提取的通道来完成任务. 一位模拟用户从Dojo探员的地面真相中回答,

blocks.en: Figure 10: Case 4: read exfiltration (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, Slack, user task 0). The injection in the page tells the Reader to fetch an attacker URL with the page text in the address. The undefended agent and Progent make the request. CaMeL never issues it. CapLite reads the page the request names, and when the Reader asks for the attacker URL, the Mediator denies the read because the URL is not stated in the request; the task is completed.
blocks.zh: 图10:案件4:已读出过滤(Quen3-4B-Instruct-2507,Slack,用户任务0). 页面中的注入让读者获取一个带有地址中页面文本的攻击者URL. 未设防的代理人和Progent提出请求. 卡梅尔从不发行 CapLite读取请求名称的页面,当读者要求攻击者URL时,调解人拒绝读取,因为请求中未声明URL;任务完成.

blocks.en: Figure 11: Case 5: the answer-only goal (Gemma-4-12B, Travel, user task 9, injection task 6). The injection asks only for a sentence in the final answer. The undefended agent, Progent, IPIGuard and CapLite repeat it, because the model reads the review text that contains it. CaMeL’s privileged model never reads the review, and DRIFT ends without an answer. CapLite executes no write here and its final answer is the only place the injection acts.
blocks.zh: 图11:案例5:只答目标(Gemma-4-12B,旅行,用户任务9,注射任务6). 注射只在最后的答案中要求句子. 未设防的代理Progent,IPIGuard和CapLite都重复,因为模型读取了包含它的审查文本. CaMeL的特权模式从未读过评论,DRIFT结束时没有答案. CapLite在此不执行写入,其最终答案是注射行为的唯一地点.
